checked.reason: A program is {steps:[...]}, a list of steps, or one step.
A step is an object with an "op".
No step "jump". The steps are to, by, wave, follow, wait, seq, par, stagger, repeat, vary, look, feature, go, burst, use, release.
This needs the argument "gone", which was not passed and has no "or".
A wave period is at least 40 ms.
signal is one of sound.level, sound.low, sound.mid, sound.high, sound.beat, run.pace, run.effort, run.context, body.speed.
A feature id is a short lowercase name such as "brow.left".
It runs 48000 ms; the most is 30000.
times is a whole number from 1 to 24.
This is one of "person", "pointer", "centre", "composer", "text", "home", "artifact", {x, y} or {thing}.
thing is a name the page lists, as "kind:id": "tool:failed", "artifact:last".
This is a time in milliseconds, 0 or more.
